messages.subject: 有關jiebaR的多檔處理程序
messages.body_plain:
您好  感謝分享成果獲益良多
我希望把一個檔案夾的多個txt檔斷詞後，放在一個新檔案夾
單文件處理沒有問題，利用loop時code可能有問題，發生讀不到檔案或無法完成程序，請求協助
Roger

R: 3.2.3
語料如附件

<
ibrary(tm)
library(jiebaR)

xdir1 = "~/R/all_ANSI/"
xdir2 = "~/R/all_ANSI_out/"
mixseg = worker()
raw <- list.files(path = xdir1, pattern = "*.txt")
for (i in raw)
{
    y = readLines(paste("xdir1",.Platform$file.sep,raw[i],sep=""), warn = F) #問題發生處
    M = mixseg<=y #問題發生處
    xpath2 = paste(xdir2,f,sep="/")  #問題發生處
    write(M,xpath2) #問題發生處
}

>

messages.body_plain:
您好，这是我读取文件用的代码。

 (ff = list.files("./",pattern = "*.txt"))
# [1] "2011010501f.txt" "2011010501u.txt" "2011010502u.txt"
# [4] "2011011301u.txt" "2011011401f.txt" "2011011801u.txt"
# [7] "2011011901f.txt" "2011011901u.txt" "2011012001f.txt"
# [10] "2011012101f.txt"
library(jiebaR)
cc = worker(bylines = T)

for (f in ff) {
 cc$output = paste0("./out/",f)
 cc[f]
}

messages.subject: 自定義詞的多檔分詞
messages.body_plain:
您好：
多檔進行分詞，又需使用自定義詞，該如何設定
試過不同參數組合，均出現<找不到物件>的錯誤訊息，請協助修正
(ff = list.files("./",pattern = "*.txt"))
library(jiebaR)

cutter = worker(bylines = TRUE)#???
cutter = worker(user  = "D:/somefile.txt")  #???
for (f in ff) {
 cutter$output = paste0("./out/",f)
 cutter[f]
}
